mentions.name: Daily meditation instrument
mentions.description: A daily meditation instrument that provides a simple timer and a couple of prompts for self-guided meditation sessions.
mentions.problem: Existing meditation apps like Waking Up offer a large catalogue that experienced meditators outgrow; this tool strips it down to just a timer and prompts for people who already know what to do.
mentions.source_excerpt: A daily meditation "instrument". I'm a big fan of Waking Up but I've kinda outgrown the catalogue. I know what to do now. I just need a timer and a couple of prompts...
mentions.author: emehex
